en: Color photo postcard showing a calm river bordered by trees with the snow‑tipped Făgăraș Mountains in the background. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, a blue 40 Bani "POSTA ROMANA" stamp (electric pylons), postmarks reading FĂGĂRAȘ, and a printed multilingual caption identifying the Olt Valley and Făgăraș Massif. Publisher line "EDITURA PENTRU TURISM" and code 1140/2 are present.
